a100.label: HGX A100 80GB x8
a100.provenance: calibrated A100 SXM4 microbenchmarks; NVLink3 / NVSwitch2 from spec
a100.caveat: The Ampere mma.sync GEMM model runs 1.5-2.4x slower than cuBLAS (decode GEMMs stream weights at ~0.8 TB/s instead of ~1.7 TB/s), so A100 step times are pessimistic and over-weight GEMMs.

b300.label: HGX B300 x8

gb300.label: GB300 NVL72
